rappel_detail.anchor: natural or fixed sling anchor at Sharkfin Col
rappel_detail.station: Sharkfin Col, on the return leg, the same technical step met on the approach. The summit descent down the southwest slopes has no rappels.
rappel_detail.notes: The one rappel, a single rope length, back onto or off the glacier side. Many parties downclimb it unroped, depending on conditions.

set.rappels: No rappels on the southwest-slopes descent itself; one short single-rope rappel (or a downclimb) at Sharkfin Col on the return leg
